fences.rule: If the cost of leaving was written into the move's own paper, a termination fee, a break fee, a notice period, a priced release, clean-exits carries it; only a bill the move's own account does not show is here.
fences.case: A break fee written into the merger agreement and paid when the buyer walks.

fences.rule: Every bill here is for a way back that can still be bought; a way back gone entirely, closed by the new state's first act that the old state cannot read, is option-expiries' Rollback horizon.
fences.case: A schema migration after the new service has written its first record in a shape the old schema rejects.

fences.rule: What sameness licenses a return and what the return does with the interval is forms-of-return's question; this map takes only the bill for coming back, so a return that deletes the interval is priced here and described there.
fences.case: forms-of-return's Hard reset, the restore that returns a file to its past state and pretends the interval never happened.

fences.rule: If protection invites settlement while it stands, that is risk-rebound-effects' levee effect; if the settlement is discovered as the bill of taking the levee down, with no denominator, it is Strangers built on it here.
fences.case: A floodplain settled behind a levee while the levee stands.

fences.rule: A record of walks that buys credibility is walkaway-manufactures' Walk on record; a record of un-walks that spends it, read by parties who held no stake in the move, is Retraction read by the room here.
fences.case: A retailer that dropped a national brand for a season and is believed the next time it threatens to.

fences.rule: A precondition a market builds or imports before a thing can be priced is market-births'; a date-setter a group cannot import for its own return without becoming subject to one is Coordination spent here.
fences.case: Sweden's drivers moved to the right on one Sunday in 1967 on a date the Riksdag set, and a return would need a second date nobody in the group can set.
